Tumbara
disciple of Timāji Raghunātha.
--Unmārgabhañjana. Hpr. III. 41.

Tumburu
legendary authority on music cited in Nāradīyaśikṣā; by Jāyasenāpati in Nṛttaratnāvalī p. 156, edn. by V. Raghavan, Mad. Govt. Ori. Ser. 107. See also ibid. intro. p. 44 an. J. of Music Academy, Madras III. p. 96. [Page195-a.
